kaikki_vikisozluk.e: ذَرْآنِيّ • (ḏarʔāniyy) (feminine ذَرْآنِيَّة (ḏarʔāniyya), masculine plural ذَرْآنِيُّون (ḏarʔāniyyūn), feminine plural ذَرْآنِيَّات (ḏarʔāniyyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From ذَرَأ (ḏaraʔ), ذُرْأَة (ḏurʔa, “whiteness”), verb ذَرَأَ (ḏaraʔa), ذَرُؤَ (ḏaruʔa, “to become white, to get whiteness intermixed into the saturated colour”)
g: white (maybe only ever used by مِلْح (milḥ) for white salt)
